column2: Hi mom this is my new number. My phone broke. Send money to my friend's account urgently and don't call.
Dad I am stranded at the hospital. Transfer money immediately. Please keep this between us.
I am your daughter. My old mobile stopped working. Pay this urgent bill to the account I send.
This is your son using a friend's phone. Send the fees now. I cannot speak on a call.
Your brother is in police custody. Transfer a release fee immediately and do not tell anyone.
I am your college principal. Buy gift cards for me urgently and send the codes privately.
This is the dean. Send payment to my personal UPI account today to confirm your admission.
I am your professor. I need an emergency transfer. Do not contact the department.
Your bank account will be blocked. Send your OTP and password to complete KYC now.
Reply with the verification code you received so our support team can restore your account.
Your wallet is frozen. Share your PIN with the agent to unlock it immediately.
We are bank security. Provide the one time password to cancel this fraudulent transaction.
KYC expired. Confirm your password at https://bank-check.example/login to avoid suspension.
Your card will be disabled in ten minutes. Tell us the security code on the back.
Congratulations you won a cash prize. Pay the processing fee first to claim your reward.
A lottery prize is waiting. Transfer the tax to our agent before we can release the money.
You have been selected for a scholarship. Send a registration deposit to this personal account.
Your loan is approved. Pay the advance service charge before receiving the funds.
We offer guaranteed investment returns. Send cryptocurrency now to double your balance tomorrow.
Deposit money to unlock your task earnings. Pay another withdrawal fee to get your profit.
Earn huge daily income from home. Send a refundable onboarding fee to start the job.
You are hired without an interview. Pay for training materials before your salary is released.
Your parcel cannot be delivered until you enter your card details at https://parcel-pay.example.
Customs detained your package. Pay a fine urgently using the link in this message.
We detected a virus. Install our remote control app and share the access code with support.
To refund your payment install screen sharing software and let our technician control your phone.
I am a police officer. Move all savings to the safe account we provide and stay on this call.
Digital arrest notice. Transfer money for verification or face prosecution. Keep this confidential.
A video of you will be published. Send money to this wallet within one hour.
Your social media is hacked. Send your login code to me and I will recover the account.
Hello mum don't ring my old phone. It is broken. I need cash for an emergency invoice today.
Please help your son urgently. I am borrowing this number. Transfer funds and don't ask questions.
I am the hostel warden. Pay a disciplinary fine to my private wallet before midnight.
The university registrar needs your student login password to release your exam results.
Your electricity connection will be cut tonight. Contact this number and make an immediate payment.
Dear customer your refund is ready. Share your banking PIN so we can credit the money.
I mistakenly sent you money. Approve the collect request and enter your UPI PIN to receive it.
Scan my payment QR and enter your PIN to receive the prize.
This is the CEO. Purchase vouchers immediately. Email the gift card numbers only to me.
Your recruiter requires a security deposit today. The interview is cancelled unless you pay now.
We guarantee a visa. Transfer an urgent appointment fee to this personal bank account.
Send a deposit to secure this rental before viewing it. The owner cannot meet you.
Your SIM will expire. Tell the customer service agent the code from your SMS right now.
Your account has suspicious activity. Send your password for our urgent investigation.
A friend needs money for surgery. Send funds immediately and keep it secret from their family.
Claim your free phone by paying a small shipping fee on this link and entering card information.
You owe a traffic fine. Pay through this unofficial link immediately to prevent arrest.
I can recover stolen money. Pay my recovery charge first and give me your wallet seed phrase.
Transfer your savings to our secure holding account. We are calling from fraud prevention.
Your interview offer is final. Send money for a laptop from our designated seller today.
Hi mom my phone battery died. I'll call from my usual number when I get home.
Dad can we discuss next term's fees at dinner? We can pay through the college portal together.
Your daughter is at the library. Please call the family number when you are free.
My new mobile number is in the family group. Please verify it by calling my old number first.
The professor posted the assignment on the official course page. Submission closes Friday.
The dean's office invites you to an open meeting on campus tomorrow. No registration fee.
Please check the university website for the fee schedule. Pay only through the official portal.
Your exam timetable is available. Log in using the bookmark you normally use.
Never share an OTP or a password with anyone, including someone claiming to be bank staff.
Bank employees will never ask for your PIN. Report anyone who requests it.
A fraudster may ask you to transfer money urgently. Stop and call your bank yourself.
Do not install remote access software on a stranger's instructions. This is a safety reminder.
Your account statement is available in the banking app. Open the app directly to view it.
A payment was received. Check the transaction details in your bank's app.
Your card was delivered. Activate it using the instructions in the official banking application.
Your KYC appointment is confirmed at the bank branch. Bring documents to the appointment.
We received your support request. Track it in the app you already use. Do not send any passwords.
Your order is out for delivery. You can check the status through the shopping app.
The parcel is at reception. Please collect it when you return to the hostel.
The job interview is scheduled for Tuesday at our office. There is no application fee.
Our college career centre has published verified internships. Apply through the placement portal.
The scholarship application closes next month. The college office can answer your questions.
The loan repayment schedule can be viewed at your bank branch or in the official app.
Investments can lose money. Read the documents and speak to an adviser before deciding.
I will bring the money I owe you when we meet tomorrow. No need to transfer anything.
Can you send the project report to our usual class group before tomorrow's lecture?
The hostel water supply is being repaired. Use the other block until noon.
Your hospital appointment is at ten. Please check in at reception fifteen minutes early.
Meet me at the canteen. I need help understanding our homework.
We are organizing a free workshop on recognizing phishing messages and fake payment requests.
Scam warning: if someone says your child is in trouble, call the child on a saved number.
The police station is holding a cyber safety session. Attendance is optional and free.
I received an urgent request for gift cards. I ignored it and checked with my manager in person.
Please approve the meeting agenda. We will discuss the budget in the office.
Your electricity bill is available in the utility app. Pay through your saved account if due.
Do not scan a QR code to receive money. Never share your UPI PIN with a caller.
The student council budget report lists fees collected and expenses paid this semester.
The train departs tomorrow morning. Your ticket is in the official rail application.
We have refunded your cancelled order to the original payment method. No action is required.
Your password was changed. If you did this, no action is needed. Otherwise open the app directly.
I am your tutor. Our lesson is cancelled today because I am unwell. See you next week.
Our family agreed to confirm unusual requests in person before sending any money.
The bank branch will close early today. Regular hours resume on Monday.
Here is the receipt for the books we bought together yesterday. I'll show you the original later.
The internship supervisor asked us to attend orientation. The company supplies equipment free.
Please review this research paper about voice cloning and identity theft for our project.
The library has renewed your book. Return it before the new due date.
There is a discount at the campus bookstore this week. You can buy books in person.
The basketball match starts at five. Bring water and meet at the sports ground.
A bank alert says an OTP was generated. Keep the code private and review your account in the app.
